doc.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Young audiences discovering older music
summary: Brief exchange: people gradually find music if they are caught by it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: How can we expect them to get into something that they’re not exposed to?
Gradually I think people find things. I mean if you’re that caught on with it, you’ll hear it.
